buildCommand: rm -rf dist .valaxy && valaxy build && mkdir -p .vercel/output/static && cp -r dist/* .vercel/output/static/ && echo '{"version":3,"routes":[{"src":"/api/(.*)","dest":"https://api.lwsnb.eu.cc/api/$1"},{"handle":"filesystem"},{"src":"/(.*)","dest":"/index.html"}]}' > .vercel/output/config.json
